title: Understand what kind of result you are viewing
summary: Labels distinguish information that was observed, calculated, simulated, predicted, or generated so you can interpret its source and limits.

items: Observed information records a source fact with its time and provenance.
Calculated information applies a declared deterministic method to known inputs.
Simulated information shows a hypothetical scenario under stated assumptions.
Predicted information is a model estimate and must show uncertainty and limits.
Generated information is model-produced content and is not an authoritative fact, grade, financial calculation, or decision.

body.text: A label explains how information was produced. It does not make the result personal investment advice or promise an outcome.

applicability.label: Project results, financial examples, simulations, model estimates, and generated explanations
